jobs.title: Junior Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
The Financial Analyst will provide essential financial and analytical support to the team, ensuring accurate financial data, forecasts, and strategic insights to support decision-making. The role involves analyzing property performance, conducting financial modeling, and reporting on financial results to guide the organization’s investment and business strategies.

Savills is a leading global real estate services company providing expertise across property advisory, investment management, valuation, property management, and consultancy. With a strong international presence, Savills works with investors, developers, landlords, and occupiers to deliver strategic real estate solutions across a wide range of markets and property sectors.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Analysis & Modeling
Develop and maintain detailed financial models to assess property investments, acquisitions, and projects.
Conduct sensitivity analysis, scenario analysis, and cash flow forecasting to evaluate the financial viability of projects.
Perform valuation analysis using various methods, including discounted cash flow (DCF), capitalization rates, and comparable sales.
Budgeting & Forecasting
Assist in preparing annual budgets and financial forecasts.
Monitor actual performance against budgeted financial targets, identify variances, and provide actionable insights.
Reporting & Presentations
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports on company and property performance.
Present financial insights and reports to senior management and key stakeholders.
Cash Flow & Asset Management
Analyze cash flows and ensure accurate tracking of income and expenses.
Collaborate with managers to assess financial and asset performance and provide recommendations for cost optimization and revenue enhancement.
Collaboration
Work closely with cross-functional teams to support financial analysis, reporting, and business objectives.

Skills, Knowledge & Experience

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. A Master’s degree or CFA designation is a plus.
Experience: 2–4 years of experience in real estate finance, investment banking, or financial analysis.
Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including financial modeling and advanced functions, as well as Power BI and PowerPoint.
Familiarity with ERP systems such as D365 or Infor is preferred.
Knowledge of real estate market trends, valuation techniques, and financial reporting.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to prepare and present financial reports effectively.
Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
Fluency in English is required.

Key Attributes

Ability to work independently and effectively as part of a team.
Strong organizational and time management skills.
High level of attention to detail and accuracy in financial analysis.

Over 42,000 people work for us in more than 700 offices all over the world. This breadth of global coverage, combined with specialist services and market insight, means we'll always have an expert who is local to you.
